facts.fact: A UNFPA Niger posting says the INS data centre and a replication site are being set up to host data of Niger's fifth census (RGPH5), with application deployment and a field pretest in July 2025 and the start of the general enumeration in December 2025.

NER.note: The INS data centre is being upgraded to host census data; it is not stated to rent space or computing to others.
Document states nothing on this study's questions.

The INS data centre is not stated to be for hire.
A replication site 140 km from Niamey is being set up, under the 200 km minimum and not yet in service.
